scope: Original split and all ten existing exploratory splits, both prespecified backbones; no new splits or representations
models: Reuse frozen regional projections and original hyperparameters; no refitting or dimension/ridge retuning
transform: Per probe and region, midrank of distances among that probe's gallery candidates, zero-based and divided by gallery size minus one
rank_ties: Exact equal input distances receive average ranks
fusion: w times upper percentile rank plus (1-w) times lower percentile rank; smaller is better
arithmetic: Use doubled zero-based midranks and integer tenths coefficients for exact fusion ties; positive common denominator omitted for ranking
weight_selection: Validation BG only; equal-person/equal-view Rank-1; tie within 1e-12 prefers nearest 0.5 then smaller upper weight
chronology: Hash inputs and implementation, select and lock weights for all eleven splits before accessing test score arrays for this new analysis
prediction_ties: Smallest numeric gallery ID among exact minimum costs; report ties for every method
labels: No probe identity is used to transform scores; labels used for BG validation selection and final evaluation only
diagnostic: For each probe and region, compute (nearest impostor distance minus genuine distance)/(maximum candidate distance minus minimum candidate distance); constant rows get zero. Also report genuine percentile rank. Summarize within person across views/repetitions, then median/IQR across people, separately by condition. Labels are used only for this descriptive diagnostic, never to calibrate or select.
reporting: Report every split/backbone/condition, selected weights, controls, per-view/mean Rank-1, exact tie counts, and person-level diagnostic summaries. Compare single-region predictions to frozen originals. No additional significance test or pooled independent-split inference.
interpretation: Sensitivity to discarding cardinal score spacing, not a causal separation of calibration from identity information. Rank fusion is established; no algorithmic novelty claim.
publication: Source and aggregates only; all per-person outcomes/diagnostics and score arrays remain private
